trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's passing health checks again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0002, which paged on-call.

- **Before:** v2.3.1 was running in us-east, us-west and eu-west and failing health checks, with an error rate of about 18%. Its release candidate, v2.3.1-rc, was also unhealthy. The newest healthy release was v2.3.0.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is now live in all three regions. The service is healthy and the error rate is down to about 0.2%.
- **Incident:** INC-0002 describes the failure, the rollback and the recovery. It also says the cause of the v2.3.1 failure needs to be found before it's deployed again. My first attempt to create the incident timed out. I checked that it hadn't gone through before trying again, so there's only one incident and on-call was paged once.
